content.subject: Fintech payments and reconciliation
content.draft_text:
Hi Chermaine,

Legacy payments weren’t built for the world fintech operates in today. Reconciliation teams spend hours each day wrestling with outdated transaction flows and manual data entry errors, which become systemic.

We build bots that match incoming payments to ledger entries without manual input.

Could we schedule a brief call next week to see if this approach fits your workflow?

Zamp
